papers.title_en: Toward Multi-kW Power Delivery Methodologies for Advanced 3D Heterogeneous Integration
papers.authors: Peiyi Yue, Hangyu Zhang, Ratul Das, Ramesh Harjani, Sachin S. Sapatnekar
papers.evidence: 面向3D异构集成芯片的供电方法学
papers.tldr: AI等应用推动系统规模迈向万亿晶体管，需依赖2D/3D异构集成与先进封装。但高算力系统功耗巨大，高功率密度与引脚数瓶颈使可靠供电成为难题，严重制约性能与可靠性。本文综述多千瓦级供电设计方法，通过多级分布式供电系统，在性能、散热与可靠性约束下优化，并探讨了关键挑战与未来方向。为先进3D异构集成提供供电方法学参考。
papers.abstract_en: The demands of modern applications require the construction of ever more complex integrated systems, with AI applications in particular serving as a significant driver for increased system size, potentially going beyond the trilliontransistor mark. The path to building these systems requires the use of advanced packaging, with heterogeneous integrated 2D and 3D chiplets placed atop a substrate. Such computationally powerful systems require significant power for computation: reliable and robust power delivery is a major challenge in light of high power densities and pin count bottlenecks. This paper overviews approaches to building design methodologies that overcome this problem, through the design of multistage distributed power delivery systems, optimized for performance and reliability, and built to coexist within stringent performance, thermal, and reliability constraints.

papers.title_en: Advanced 400G-SerDes Modulations and Equalizers for GPU Cluster in AI Era
papers.authors: Sheng Chen, Zhengxiang Cheng, Ji Zhou, Haide Wang, Mengqi Guo, Weiping Liu, Liangchuan Li, Xiangjun Xin
papers.evidence: 面向高速互连的400G SerDes调制与均衡
papers.tldr: 面向AI时代GPU集群互连从200Gbps升级至400Gbps的需求，研究高阶调制与均衡。推导PAM4/PAM8理论BER及六种由32QAM生成的PAM6近似BER，并仿真440Gbps线路速率下不同带宽限制。结果表明PAM4在轻度带宽受限时PSNR最优，PAM6在中度受限时最佳，PAM8在严重受限时优势显著；结合MLSE后PAM6/PAM8均达KP4-FEC限，PAM6多数信道所需PSNR更低，展现400G-SerDes潜力。
papers.abstract_en: High-speed GPU cluster interconnects are evolving from 200 to 400 Gbps to meet the growing computing demands of artificial intelligence. We investigate high-order modulation and advanced equalization for 400 Gbps interconnects. Theoretical bit error rate (BER) expressions for 4/8-ary pulse amplitude modulation (PAM) and approximate expressions for six PAM6 formats generated from 32-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (32QAM) are derived. In additive white Gaussian noise, PAM6 generated by framed-cross 32QAM achieves the best BER performance among the PAM6 formats. PAM6 and PAM8 incur peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) penalties of approximately 4.2 and 7.2 dB, respectively, relative to PAM4 at the KP4 forward error correction (KP4-FEC) limit. Simulations compare PAM4, PAM6, and PAM8 at a line rate of 440 Gbps (net rate of 400G) under different bandwidth limitations. As bandwidth becomes more constrained, bandwidth requirements increasingly dominate performance over noise tolerance. PAM4 requires the lowest PSNR to reach the KP4-FEC limit in mildly bandwidth-limited channels, whereas PAM6 performs best under moderate limitations. PAM8 offers a significant advantage under severe limitations because of its lower bandwidth requirement and reduced susceptibility to high-frequency attenuation. With maximum likelihood sequence estimation, PAM6 and PAM8 reach the KP4-FEC limit under all evaluated channel conditions, while PAM6 requires a lower PSNR in most channels, highlighting its potential for 400G-SerDes systems.
